links.outcome: Safety, correctness and guideline adherence of guideline-grounded chatbot answers, rated by an LLM judge
links.effect: 95.3% rated completely safe, 79.1% completely correct, only 45.0% fully guideline-adherent; agreement with physician assessment was weak.
links.quote: In the LLM-based evaluation, 95.3% of answers were rated as completely safe and 79.1% as completely correct.

unlisted_practices: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of chatbot responses compared with rheumatologist ratings
Analysis of user questions and feedback to guide iterative improvement of source content and patient education materials
Co-development of disease-specific chatbots with rheumatology centres and patient organisations

screen.reason: Empirical study reporting on the real-world deployment and user evaluation of 10 guideline-grounded LLM chatbots across 13 rheumatology centres and six patient organisations.
